'''Protector of the People''' is a [[title]] of the [[Queen]] of [[Andor]]. It is not exactly known how the title came to be part of the royal styling. It may be due to Andor's treatment of the common people being better compared to other nations. Currently, [[Elayne Trakand]] holds the title. Her mother, [[Morgase Trakand]] held the title when she was queen.
